# Design

Pairing is server/remote/pairing.ts: remote.enabled in config, bindHost read once at boot, one in-memory pending window {code, token, expires, tries}, MAX_ATTEMPTS 5, CODE_TTL_MS 5 min, MAX_DEVICES 16, MAX_NAME 60; claimPairing compares with a length-gated timingSafeEqual and stores sha256(token) only; deviceForToken hashes the offered token and compares digests. The remote gate in server/index.ts requires remoteEnabled and same origin, then a device token, and allow-lists exactly GET /api/health and POST /api/pair/claim before a device is anybody. The relay is server/remote/relay-link.ts (RelayLink: configure, dial, publish, serve, backoff, keepalive, watchdog, generation counter, nonce set cleared every REPLAY_WINDOW_MS) over server/remote/relay-crypto.ts (deviceKey via hkdfSync with INFO workmates-relay-v1 and a per-direction info string, seal/open/peek on a {d, n, c} envelope). A relayed request carries x-workmates-relay with a per-boot INTERNAL secret and x-workmates-relay-device, and is replayed against the Mac's own HTTP surface with local=false. Activation is POST /api/relay/activate: CLOUD_KEY shape check, POST {relayBase()}/spaces with the key as a bearer, redactSecrets on quoted errors, save {url, agentToken, clientToken, enabled}. relayBase() prefers config, then WORKMATES_RELAY_URL, then https://relay.workmate.centra.ag. UI: DevicesSection.tsx (switch, Pair a phone, QR on white, code, countdown, cancel, paired list with revoke) and CloudSection.tsx (key input, Activate, Connected or Reconnecting pill, spaceId, Replace).
